checks.countsUnknown: This report records no test counts.
checks.modelClaim: Only a check the runtime executed is evidence. A model's claim that tests passed is not.
checks.none: This run recorded no acceptance report, so nothing here was verified.
checks.revisionMissing: The report names no revision, so it proves nothing about the delivered change.
checks.tierUnattested: Not attested. The report does not say which sandbox ran the command, so treat the isolation as unproven.
checks.title: Acceptance checks

patch.comparedMoved: Your workspace has moved to {revision} since this patch was made against {base}. The comparison below is against your workspace as it is now, not against the base.
patch.comparedNow: Compared against your workspace, which is still at the patch's base revision.
patch.comparedUnavailable: Your workspace could not be read on this device, so every line is shown as added.

deliveryValue.patch_only: Patch only — your workspace was not changed

patch.downloadFailed: The patch could not be saved.
patch.expired: The patch document is no longer stored — patch content is kept for seven days — so it cannot be shown or downloaded.

file.baseUnavailable: The current file could not be read here, so every line is shown as added.

patch.title: Patch
patch.unchanged: This file's content is identical to your workspace's.

progress.none: This run recorded no delegate steps.
progress.title: Delegation

approval.mismatch: This view is out of date: the run is waiting on a different request. Reopen the run to decide.
approval.title: Waiting for your decision

what.scope_expansion: The worker asks to change files outside the paths its subtask allowed. Approving allows exactly these paths, at exactly this revision.
what.workspace_apply: The verified patch is ready to be written into your workspace. Approving applies it only while your workspace is still at the base revision; if it moved, nothing is written.

review.applyElsewhere: This run delivered a patch only. Applying it into your workspace needs a run that asks for it, so that the write goes through the same approval and conflict check.
review.title: Delegation review
review.unavailable: The delegation record could not be read on this device: {reason}

settings.desc: A delegation is accepted only on a report produced by a command the project declares in .cognia/workspace.json, and only once you approve that exact command. Changing the command asks again.
settings.needsMaster: Turn on the master switch to review acceptance profiles.
settings.noProjects: No project yet. An acceptance profile lives in a project's workspace configuration.

reason.ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE_APPROVAL_FAILED: the approval could not be stored
reason.ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE_CHANGED: the command changed after it was shown; review it again
reason.ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE_MISSING: the project no longer declares it
reason.ACCEPTANCE_PROFILE_UNTRUSTED: trust this workspace before approving its commands
reason.APPROVAL_STORE_FAILED: the approval store could not be written

settings.revokeFailed: The approval of "{profile}" was not withdrawn: {reason}
settings.runCapDesc: The most one delegation may spend, across every model call it makes. An action of its own may set a lower cap.
settings.title: Acceptance profiles

unavailable.absent: This project declares no acceptance profile, so a delegation cannot be verified in it.
unavailable.approval_pending: Nothing is approved yet, so a delegation cannot run in this project.
unavailable.fault: The project's configuration could not be read: {message}
unavailable.invalid: The project's acceptance profiles could not be parsed: {message}
unavailable.restricted: This workspace is not trusted, so its configuration was not read.
